caseName: Baltimore Refrigerating & Heating Co. v. Wetzel
caseNameFull: The Baltimore Refrigerating & Heating Company of Baltimore City v. Frank G. Wetzel, etc.

opinions.text: Petition for a writ of certiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit denied. Mr. George Whitelock and Mr. Robert H. Smith for petitioner: Mr. W. Calvin Chesnutt and Mr. Charles Markell, Jr., for respondents.
